sources.title: Ulster Museum/Habitas — Pagurus bernhardus
sources.scope: Selected actual species account read: right-major bumpy/spinose chelae, short pointed rostrum, reduced P4/P5 shell-support limbs and soft curled abdomen. Dense bristles not inferred. Account does not determine the gastropod shell in the separate source photo.

sources.title: Ege etal2025 — Pagurus bernhardus chela shape and shell relationships
sources.scope: Selected primary HTML abstract/methods read; actual Fig2 image viewed for distinct right/left chela/propodus contours. No fitted allometry, reconstructed experimental individual or whole-animal gait imported. Direct local PDF fetch returned HTML; the figure image was independently accessible and is linked privately, not redistributed.

retrieval.accessMethod: Selected primary HTML plus actual linked Figure2

sources.title: Chapple2012 — walking in related Pagurus pollicarus
sources.scope: Primary abstract and selected indexed introductory passage read only. Related-species P2/P3 walking and P4/P5 shell support inform qualitative context; not measured P.bernhardus coordinates, phases, forces or shell loads.

findings.shape: Original short anterior shield, short ocular stalks, larger right granular chela and smaller left chela replace an undifferentiated draft. Four principal walking limbs are distinct from reduced P4/P5 shell-support cues. A partial soft curled pleon is enclosed by an open helicospiral shelter of undetermined gastropod taxon; that shell is not counted as another species.
findings.surface: Selected cream/orange mottled cuticle with seated granule/spinule cues and greenish eye ends follows the authentic reference qualitatively. The original numeric shell has continuous whorls, a lip, inner wall and subdued worn pigment. No source photo pixels or measured material calibration are used.
findings.movement: The retained four principal limbs perform a short authored supported bout with fixed segment lengths, planted-toe support/recovery and stopping. Unequal fingers and antennae articulate locally; quiet rest retains the shell and body. Full withdrawal, shell closure, shell choice, food handling/contact and shell-load dynamics remain unavailable.
findings.evidenceScope: Authentic Hans Hillewaert CC BY-SA4.0 photo compared with selected actual Ulster Museum/Habitas species diagnosis and Ege etal2025 Figure2 right/left chela contours. Primary selected HTML abstract/methods and actual linked figure were accessible; a direct local PDF request returned HTML and is not claimed as read. Chapple2012 walking context is a related Pagurus species and not a measured P.bernhardus gait.
corrections: Created unequal right-major/left-minor chelae with original granular surfaces and finger articulation.
Lowered claws that initially extended too far sideways and increased the initially thin principal limb surfaces after rendered photo comparison.
Separated four principal support limbs from reduced P4/P5 and a partial soft curled pleon.
Revised the shelter coil progression after separated-looking whorls were visible in side view; continuous open shelter retained across actions.
Kept full withdrawal unavailable instead of shrinking the whole mature body.
findings.residual: Still partly stylized: the eye region and mouthparts are simplified, limb segmentation and exact claw allometry are unmeasured, some shell-opening/body relationships remain schematic and shell support/load is not solved. The illustrative shell does not reconstruct the reference individual's identified gastropod species, handedness or dimensions. No independent biological validation or measured gait/physiology.

limits: Partly stylized original educational reconstructions. Proportions, natural cuticle optics, biological timing, forces, food contact, sensing and physiology are incomplete or unmeasured. No independent specialist validation, scientific certification or accuracy percentage. Software checks and screenshots are not empirical validation.
